Join the Team

Careers at Regulus

Regulus builds the full-spectrum Counter-UAS ecosystem: detect, track, identify, and neutralize aerial threats end-to-end. From our original GNSS-spoofing breakthrough to our unified command platform and our upcoming kinetic interceptor, every system we ship is validated in active combat, by the militaries that depend on it.

TRL-9 is our standard, not our aspiration. You’ll own entire problems, not tickets. When an operator in the field says “we need this next,” that conversation becomes the roadmap, protocol libraries update monthly, AI models retrain quarterly, and new capabilities ship continuously, because the threat doesn’t wait.

We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders across the stack: RF, GNSS, signal processing, C++ and Python, field ops, integration. What unites the team is simpler than a stack: the belief that the work matters, and a refusal to ship anything that fails in the field.

Current Opportunities

We move fast, without compromising quality. We review every application carefully and aim to respond as quickly as possible. If there’s a strong fit, you can expect to hear from us shortly.


We hire people who bring deep expertise in one area, along with the curiosity and ability to work across domains. At Regulus, engineers and operators often collaborate beyond traditional boundaries, RF meets software, software meets signal processing, and everything connects through real-world systems.


We value real experience and impact over keywords. Whether your background is in defense, commercial tech, academia, or military service, we’re interested in the work you’re most proud of.


This isn’t just another role. It’s a chance to join a group of exceptional people at an exciting stage, to build, develop, create infrastructure, and lead. To have real impact, grow with us, and ultimately, help save lives.
